articles.summary: Proven industrial technology executive to lead the industry’s leading lighting business ATLANTA, Aug. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Acuity Inc. (NYSE: AYI) appoints Ruth Gratzke as President of Acuity Brands Lighting (ABL) effective September 1, 2026. She will report to Neil Ashe, Acuity CEO.
articles.title: Acuity Inc. Names Ruth Gratzke President of Acuity Brands Lighting
